title: Mandarin Connect — Case Study 01: Chitungwiza → Beijing
_note: say = text sent to ElevenLabs (Chinese characters where Mandarin must be pronounced); cap = on-screen caption.

lines.say: 你好！
lines.cap: Nǐ hǎo!

lines.say: Wait. Did you hear that? That was hello. 你好.
lines.cap: Wait. Did you hear that? That was hello. Nǐ hǎo.

lines.say: 你好! I'm Teacher Wen. Today, we teach Mandarin to a learner from Chitungwiza.
lines.cap: Nǐ hǎo! I’m Teacher Wen. Today, we teach Mandarin to a learner from Chitungwiza.

lines.say: Chitungwiza to Beijing. Mandarin for absolute beginners. Let's watch.
lines.cap: Chitungwiza to Beijing. Mandarin for absolute beginners. Let’s watch.

lines.say: Meet Tendai. Thirteen, from Chitungwiza. Mandarin? Zero words.
lines.cap: Meet Tendai. Thirteen, from Chitungwiza. Mandarin? Zero words.

lines.say: Perfect. Zero is my favourite place to start.
lines.cap: Perfect. Zero is my favourite place to start.

lines.say: First, where does Mandarin come from? Three thousand years of written history.
lines.cap: First, where does Mandarin come from? Three thousand years of written history.

lines.say: Give us the highlights!
lines.cap: Give us the highlights!

lines.say: In 221 BC, 秦始皇, the first emperor, gives China one script.
lines.cap: 221 BC: Qín Shǐhuáng, the first emperor, gives China one script.

lines.say: The 汉 dynasty gives characters their name: 汉字.
lines.cap: The Hàn dynasty gives characters their name: Hànzì.

lines.say: Wait. Kublai Khan? The Mongol emperor?
lines.cap: Wait. Kublai Khan? The Mongol emperor?

lines.say: Yes! His 元 dynasty made Beijing the capital. Later, the 明 emperors rebuilt the Great Wall.
lines.cap: Yes! His Yuán dynasty made Beijing the capital. Later, the Míng emperors rebuilt the Great Wall.

lines.say: And Mandarin? It comes from 官话: the speech of the emperor's officials.
lines.cap: And “Mandarin”? It comes from Guānhuà: the speech of the emperor’s officials.

lines.say: So Tendai is learning the language of emperors. No pressure!
lines.cap: So Tendai is learning the language of emperors. No pressure!

lines.say: Lesson one. Tones. Listen. 妈。 麻。 马。 骂。
lines.cap: Lesson one. Tones. Listen. Mā. Má. Mǎ. Mà.

lines.say: Wait, did you hear that? Same sound. Four different words.
lines.cap: Wait, did you hear that? Same sound. Four different words.

lines.say: Mother. Hemp. Horse. Scold. Change the tone, change the meaning.
lines.cap: Mother. Hemp. Horse. Scold. Change the tone, change the meaning.

lines.say: Here's the secret. Tendai already speaks a tonal language: Shona.
lines.cap: Here’s the secret. Tendai already speaks a tonal language: Shona.

lines.say: Exactly. Shona uses tone too, so Tendai's ear is already trained.
lines.cap: Exactly. Shona uses tone too, so Tendai’s ear is already trained.

lines.say: Lesson two. Point, and say. 眼睛. Eyes.
lines.cap: Lesson two. Point and say. Yǎnjing: eyes.

lines.say: 眼睛.
lines.cap: Yǎnjing.

lines.say: 鼻子. Nose. 嘴. Mouth.
lines.cap: Bízi: nose. Zuǐ: mouth.

lines.say: 鼻子. 嘴. Okay, that's actually easy.
lines.cap: Bízi. Zuǐ. Okay, that’s actually easy.

lines.say: Lesson three. Characters are pictures. This is 人. A person, walking.
lines.cap: Lesson three. Characters are pictures. This is rén: a person, walking.

lines.say: 口, an open mouth. 木, a tree. Two trees? 林. A forest.
lines.cap: Kǒu: an open mouth. Mù: a tree. Two trees? Lín: a forest.

lines.say: Hold on. Two trees make a forest? That's genius.
lines.cap: Hold on. Two trees make a forest? That’s genius.

lines.say: And 日, the sun. See the picture, never forget it.
lines.cap: And rì: the sun. See the picture, never forget it.

lines.say: Day five. Tendai stands up in class. Listen.
lines.cap: Day five. Tendai stands up in class. Listen.

lines.say: 你好！我叫 Tendai。我是津巴布韦人。
lines.cap: Nǐ hǎo! Wǒ jiào Tendai. Wǒ shì Jīnbābùwéi rén.

lines.say: Wait, did you hear that? My name is Tendai, I'm Zimbabwean. Beautiful tones! 太棒了！
lines.cap: Wait, did you hear that? “My name is Tendai, I’m Zimbabwean.” Beautiful tones! Tài bàng le!

lines.say: Five days. Four tones, twelve words, five picture characters, and a first conversation.
lines.cap: Five days. Four tones, twelve words, five picture characters, and a first conversation.

lines.say: That's how we teach. Pictures, stories, tone games, and speaking from day one.
lines.cap: That’s how we teach. Pictures, stories, tone games, and speaking from day one.

lines.say: Parents: if a beginner can do this in five days, imagine your child after a term.
lines.cap: Parents: if a beginner can do this in five days, imagine your child after a term.

lines.say: Mandarin Connect starts with Form One, in January twenty twenty-seven.
lines.cap: Mandarin Connect starts with Form 1, in January 2027.

lines.say: Royal Crest Academy. Call or WhatsApp zero seven one four, four zero four, zero nine zero.
lines.cap: Royal Crest Academy. Call or WhatsApp 0714 404 090.

lines.say: 再见！
lines.cap: Zàijiàn! Goodbye!
